name: guardian
description: One security policy for every guard mod — permissive, standard or strict — plus a project safety score.

level.title: Security level
level.description: The policy for projects that have no .claude/guardian.json of their own. permissive: few interruptions; standard: the guards' own defaults; strict: tightest settings plus guardian's own fallback guard; custom: standard, with the overrides in .claude/guardian.json.

fallback.title: Fallback guard at strict
fallback.description: At the strict level, block the most critical cases (rm -rf of a root, force push to main, curl | sh, secrets written to files, .env reads, terraform destroy) for each guard mod that is not installed.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: The marketplace the guard mods are installed from; pluginConfigs keys and install commands use it.
